title: Mjukvaruutvecklare inom Embedded C & AUTOSAR (Drivlina/EV)
description:
Vill du vara med och utveckla nästa generations eldrivna fordon? Vi söker nu en erfaren Embedded Software Engineer som vill ta ett helhetsansvar för utveckling av plattformsmjukvara till styrsystem (ECU) inom drivlina – hela vägen från prototyp till serieproduktion.  

**Om uppdraget**
I den här rollen arbetar du nära hårdvaran och ansvarar för utvecklingen av komplex plattformsmjukvara (low-level och middleware) baserad på AUTOSAR-arkitektur. Du täcker hela utvecklingscykeln och säkerställer att säkerhetskritiska komponenter för elfordon håller högsta kvalitet och tillförlitlighet.


Huvudsakliga ansvarsområden:

* Kravdefinition, arkitektur, detaljdesign, uppskattning och implementering.
* Enhetstestning, integrationstestning och dokumentation samt kodgranskning (code reviews).
* Implementering av mjukvara baserad på AUTOSAR för styrsystem (ECU).
* Design-, utvecklings- och felsökningssupport vid integration av enskilda funktioner i styrsystemet.

  

  

  

**Profil & Kvalifikationer**
Vi söker dig som har en stark teknisk bakgrund inom inbyggda system, trivs i agila team och kommunicerar tydligt med dina kollegor. Du ska tala flytande svenska och engelska.


Tekniska kraven för rollen:

* Excellenta kunskaper i Embedded C (inklusive förståelse för kompilatorer och linkers) samt erfarenhet av C/C++.
* Erfarenhet av AUTOSAR och utveckling av lågnivådrivrutiner för mikrokontrollers peripherals (DI, DO, ADC, DAC, Timer, PWM, DMA, Watchdog etc.).
* God kunskap om OS-kodningstekniker och kommunikationsprotokoll såsom CAN, SPI, LIN och UART.
* Hands-on erfarenhet av verkyg för on-chip debugging och felsökning av både mjuk- och hårdvara.
* Erfarenhet av versionshantering (Git, SVN), agila metodiker (Scrum/Kanban) samt verktyg för ärende- och testhantering.

**Vad vi erbjuder**


	+ En unika möjlighet att bygga värdefull erfarenhet och ett starkt nätverk hos ledande aktörer inom fordons- och techsektorn.
	+ En ambitiös, öppen och innovativ miljö där vi stöttar varandra och har nära till beslut.
	+ Vi omfattas av Innovationsavtalet vilket garanterar marknadsmässiga villkor, tjänstepension, föräldraledighetstillägg samt schyssta arbetstids- och semestervillkor.
	+ Plats: Göteborg.**Ansökan och kontakt**


Urval och intervjuer sker löpande och tjänsten kan komma att tillsättas innan sista ansökningsdatum, så vänta inte med din ansökan!


Vi strävar efter en rekryteringsprocess fri från diskriminering och fördomar. Vi välkomnar sökande oavsett kön, könsidentitet eller uttryck, ålder, etnisk tillhörighet, religion eller annan trosuppfattning, funktionsvariation, sexuell läggning eller bakgrund.

title: Software Engineer (Golang)
description:
**Description**
 Welcome to SSC Space (formerly Swedish Space Corporation), the perfect workplace for those passionate about technology in general and space in particular.
   

  

 With space organizations, research institutes, institutional and commercial actors as customers, we offer specialist expertise in satellite communications, space consulting services, rocket and balloon systems, flight test services, satellite propulsion systems, and much more.
   

  

 SSC Space also has one of the world’s largest global networks of ground stations for satellite communications. We own and operate the Esrange Space Center in Kiruna, northern Sweden, with the aim of launching satellites in the near future.
   

  

 Are you ready to embark on an exciting journey with us to help Earth benefit from space?
   

  

 If you answer yes to this question, we invite you to seize the opportunity to make a significant impact as Software Engineer in our team. We are looking for a dedicated person who shares our core values of Customer passion, Care, Collaboration, Curiosity, and Courage.
   

  

 The Software unit within SSC Connect is entrusted to develop and maintain critical systems required to connect our customers with their satellites. As our Software Engineer, you’ll develop and maintain the critical systems that keep our customers connected with their satellites every day.
   

  

**Requirements**
 We think that you care - about your systems, your colleagues, and your users. That you have a creative and analytical mindset. You take responsibility, drive your own initiatives, and can learn and process technical details quickly. We also think that you appreciate both working autonomously and together with other people.
   

  

 We believe you have a BSc or similar degree in Computer Science or Engineering and several years of experience in software development.
   

  

 To succeed in this role, you should have:
   

  

* Proven experience in Go development
* Proven experience with git
* Proven experience with unit testing and system test scripting
* Experience developing and deploying applications on cloud platforms
* Solid knowledge of Linux environments
* Excellent communication skills in English.


**We Also Value If You Have Experience With**
* Experience building scalable and reliable infrastructure on cloud platforms
* Knowledge of Kubernetes
* Experience with message bus technologies (RabbitMq, NATS, Kafka)
* API development experience (RESTful / JSON / XML)
* Familiarity with DevOps and CI/CD methodologies
* Experience with databases (SQL/NoSQL)
* Interest or experience within the space industry.


 You must hold EU citizenship and be able to travel occasionally.
   

  

 This role is also critical for our operational services and may include participation in an on-call rotation (up to one week per month).
   

  

**Responsibilities**
 We are seeking an experienced software engineer to:
   

  

* Build and maintain high-quality software for mission-critical applications.
* Advance automation in testing, deployment, and delivery.
* Enhance observability through monitoring, logging, and alerting solutions.
* Contribute to continuous improvement within our agile teams.
* Support live missions and ensure system reliability in production.


**Benefits**
**We offer you**
* A unique opportunity to contribute to a wide range of projects and play an active role in both the Swedish and international space industry.
* An excellent opportunity for personal and career development.
* An exciting, international workplace characterized by an open atmosphere and proud employees all over the world.


**Additional benefits**
* In addition to vacation and traditional public holidays, we offer extra paid leave throughout the year, such as time off between Christmas and New Year, Ascension Day, amounting to 6-11 extra days depending on the calendar.
* Wellness allowance of SEK 5,000 per year.
* Health benefits such as voluntary health insurance and regular health checks for eligible employees.
* Access to a benefit bike through a tax-efficient leasing program.
* Support for employee-driven activities that promote connection, health, and culture across teams.
* Collective Agreement, including good pensions plans, parental pay and insurance.


**LOCATION** 

 This is a full-time, permanent position based at our office in either Solna or Kiruna.
   

  

**FURTHER INFORMATION**
 For questions regarding the position, you are welcome to contact:
   

  

 Jenny Rudenstål, Global Software Engineering Manager: jenny.rudenstal@sscspace.com.
   

  

 For questions regarding employment terms or union-related matters, you are welcome to contact our union representatives:
   

  

 Sveriges Ingenjörer: SverigesIngenjorer-AF@sscspace.com
   

  

 Unionen: unionen@sscspace.com
   

  

  

  

**NEXT STEP** 

 If this opportunity sparks your interest, we encourage you to apply as soon as possible! We review applications continuously and will conduct interviews throughout the process.
   

  

 You can submit your application up until 2026-08-27, which is the latest possible date for consideration.
   

  

 Please note, however, that the position may be filled before this date, and the advertisement may therefore close earlier. This allows us to manage the process efficiently and give each application the attention it deserves.
   

  

 When applying, please include your CV. While you are welcome to include a brief personal note or letter, our evaluation will primarily focus on your skills and qualifications as outlined in your CV, ensuring a fair and unbiased recruitment process.
   

  

 This position requires approved pre-employment screening. These controls are based on the role that you will fulfill within the company. Additional requirements regarding citizenship may apply.
   

  

**WE HELP EARTH BENEFIT FROM SPACE**
 SSC Space is a leading global provider of advanced space services, with more than 50 years of experience. We help space organizations, research institutes, commercial and institutional actors from all over the world to get access to space.
   

  

 With local presence on all continents and about 700 committed employees, we offer specialist expertise in satellite communications and satellite control services, spacecraft operations, rocket and balloon systems, launch services and flight test services, as well as engineering, operations and consultancy services for space missions.
   

  

 We help Earth benefit from Space. Learn more at sscspace.com

title: Senior Fullstack Engineer
description:
The Platform team creates the technology that enables Spotify to learn quickly and scale easily, enabling rapid growth in our users and our business around the globe. Spanning many disciplines, we work to make the business work, creating the infrastructure, tooling, frameworks, and capabilities needed to welcome a billion customers.
   

  

 Our team builds Groove, a platform that helps thousands of employees plan, coordinate, and deliver work across Spotify. From initiative tracking to dependency management and collaborative planning, Groove helps teams stay aligned and execute with confidence.
   

  

 We're a small, cross-functional engineering team focused on building thoughtful tools that reduce friction and help people do their best work. We move quickly, learn from user feedback, and continuously improve the experiences we build.
   

  

 What You'll Do:
   

  

* Build and evolve Groove, a fullstack platform that supports planning, collaboration, and execution across Spotify.
* Design and deliver features including initiative tracking, planning workflows, and dependency management.
* Work across the stack using React, TypeScript, Java, GraphQL, PostgreSQL, and Google Kubernetes Engine (GKE) to build end-to-end solutions.
* Partner closely with product managers and designers to understand user needs and create intuitive, effective experiences.
* Ensure reliability through testing, monitoring, and continuous improvement in production.
* Participate in an on-call rotation and help respond to production incidents when needed.
* Improve the performance, scalability, and maintainability of frontend and backend systems.
* Use AI-assisted development tools to improve productivity while maintaining ownership of quality, correctness, and outcomes.
* Lead the design and delivery of complex, high-impact features across the stack.
* Own problems end-to-end, from shaping ambiguous requirements through to production-ready solutions.
* Help define and evolve architecture across frontend, backend, and infrastructure.
* Mentor engineers and contribute to raising the technical bar across the team.


 Who You Are:
   

  

* You have 5+ years of experience building scalable fullstack applications in production environments.
* You are comfortable working across frontend and backend technologies and understand how they fit together to create reliable products.
* You have experience with APIs, distributed systems, and modern web application architecture.
* You take ownership of the software you build, from implementation through production health and ongoing improvements.
* You have experience designing systems and influencing technical direction.
* You communicate clearly and effectively through documentation and collaboration in distributed teams.
* You write clean, maintainable code that enables others to build with confidence.
* You use AI-assisted development tools thoughtfully and validate outputs with sound engineering judgment.
* You navigate ambiguity with confidence and make thoughtful trade-offs between speed, quality, and long-term maintainability.
* You enjoy mentoring others, sharing knowledge, and helping teammates grow.
* You are curious, proactive, and motivated by continuous learning and experimentation.


 Where You'll Be:
   

  

* This role is based in London or Stockholm.
* We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best! There will be some in person meetings, but still allows for flexibility to work from home.


 Spotify is an equal opportunity employer. You are welcome at Spotify for who you are, no matter where you come from, what you look like, or what’s playing in your headphones. Our platform is for everyone, and so is our workplace. The more voices we have represented and amplified in our business, the more we will all thrive, contribute, and be forward-thinking! So bring us your personal experience, your perspectives, and your background. It’s in our differences that we will find the power to keep revolutionizing the way the world listens.
   

  

 At Spotify, we are passionate about inclusivity and making sure our entire recruitment process is accessible to everyone. We have ways to request reasonable accommodations during the interview process and help assist in what you need. If you need accommodations at any stage of the application or interview process, please let us know - we’re here to support you in any way we can.
   

  

 We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us. Find our AI notice here: https://lifeatspotify.com/ai-notice
   

  

 Today, we are the world’s most popular audio streaming subscription service.

title: iOS Utvecklare till B3 Mobile
description:
B3 Mobile är koncernens spetsbolag för apputveckling. Vi bygger framtidens digitala lösningar tillsammans med några av världens mest spännande kunder – i Stockholm och internationellt. Våra projekt spänner över iOS, Android, Kotlin, Swift, TypeScript, React Native, Java och mycket mer.
   

  

 Nu söker vi en erfaren iOS-utvecklare som vill ta nästa steg i karriären och bli en del av vårt passionerade team.
   

  

**Rollen**
 Hos oss får du arbeta nära andra skickliga utvecklare, UX-designers och projektledare – både in-house och ute hos kund. Vi vill inte bara bygga det kunden ber om, utan gärna leda utvecklingen, modernisera och driva på användandet av de senaste teknikerna inom iOS när det behövs.
   

  

 Vi jobbar primärt med Swift och SwiftUI, men erfarenhet av UIKit och andra delar av Apples ekosystem är alltid meriterande. Kännedom om Objective‑C kan vara värdefullt, men är inget krav.
   

  

**Vi letar efter dig som**
* Har minst 6 års erfarenhet av iOS-utveckling
* Har mycket goda kunskaper i Swift, SwiftUI och Xcode
* Har erfarenhet av UIKit och gärna insyn i övriga delar av ekosystemet
* Har vana av byggautomatisering (t.ex. Fastlane, Xcode Cloud)
* Har dokumenterad erfarenhet av testning och unittester (Swift Testing, XCTest)
* Skriver ren, hållbar, läsbar, säker, modulär och testbar kod
* Är proaktiv och gillar att ta initiativ hos kund
* Har en bakgrund som civilingenjör eller motsvarande erfarenhet
* Talar och skriver svenska obehindrat


**Därför ska du välja oss**
 Vi erbjuder mer än bara ett jobb – hos oss får du:
   

  

* Möjlighet att jobba med tekniskt utmanande lösningar för högprofilerade kunder.
* Friheten att alltid ha de bästa verktygen: snabb dator, gott om testtelefoner, rätt tangentbord, alla kablar och licenser du behöver – på eget initiativ.
* Flexibelt upplägg med hybridmodell (en dag i veckan på kontoret för gemenskap och kunskapsutbyte).
* En arbetsplats där du kan växa och utforska de senaste teknikerna tillsammans med ett starkt team.
* Satsningar på ditt välmående – från friskvårdsbidrag till en arbetsmiljö där balans mellan jobb och fritid är en självklarhet.


 Vi tror på energi, nyfikenhet och att dela erfarenheter. Hos oss är olikheter en styrka, och vi vill att du ska känna att du kan växa – både som utvecklare och som människa.
   

  

 För mer information kontakta VD Anders Nilsson på Anders.Nilsson@b3.se
