title: System Developer - Cybersecurity
description:
We are looking for a System Developer who can blend software development expertise with a strong interest in security. In this role, you’ll contribute directly to RaySearch’s mission: advancing cancer treatment through innovative software. By ensuring that our products are designed and implemented securely, you help protect both patients and healthcare professionals and strengthen the reliability of the tools they depend on.
   

  

**About The Role**
 As a System Developer within cybersecurity, you will play a key role in shaping our secure development practices. You will work closely with development teams to embed security into the software development lifecycle and ensure that our products follow industry-leading standards. The role combines hands-on application security work—such as secure code reviews, threat modeling, and penetration testing—with knowledge sharing, training, and collaborative support to help teams make informed security decisions.
   

  

 This is an ideal role for a developer who enjoys cybersecurity and wants to contribute by guiding others, elevating security awareness, and helping teams work securely and effectively together.
   

  

**Your main tasks**
* Work with development teams to implement application security best practices throughout the SDLC.
* Participate in threat modeling (e.g., STRIDE) and risk assessments for new and existing applications.
* Assist in designing and implementing cybersecurity controls in products.
* Ensure compliance with cybersecurity frameworks and standards.
* Contribute to developer security awareness training and promote secure development practices.
* Perform secure code reviews, static/dynamic analysis, and penetration testing.
* Develop and maintain secure coding guidelines and security documentation.
* Support the preparation of cybersecurity documentation for regulated products (including FDA-related frameworks).


**Your profile**
 You are a developer with a strong interest in cybersecurity and secure design. You enjoy sharing knowledge, collaborating with others, and supporting development teams in building secure solutions. You communicate clearly, work constructively across functions, and contribute to a culture where security is a natural part of everyday development.
   

  

**Required Skills**
* Strong understanding of software development practices and the ability to read, analyze, and evaluate code for security and quality aspects.
* Strong understanding of application security principles (e.g., OWASP Top 10, secure coding).
* Experience with threat modeling and risk analysis.
* Excellent ability to produce clear, structured security and compliance documentation.


**It’s an advantage, but not required, if you also have experience of:**
* Working in regulated environments (e.g., medical devices, embedded systems).
* Hands-on experience with security testing tools (e.g., SonarQube, Burp Suite).
* Familiarity with FDA cybersecurity guidelines, the IEC 8100x series, or IEC 62443 for industrial/embedded systems.
* Integrating security into CI/CD pipelines (Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions).


**Our Culture**
 Culture at RaySearch is the driving force behind our organization, where everything we do is driven by a shared passion for innovation and the fight against cancer. Our dedication is reflected in our ability to deliver exceptional results, pay close attention to detail, and consistently go the extra mile. Our employees stand out as experts in their field, driven by a relentless focus on solving problems - no matter how complex. At RaySearch, we take pride in leading the way in cancer treatment, leveraging cutting-edge technology to develop innovative solutions that make a real difference in patient care.
   

  

**Our Offer**
 At RaySearch, we offer a diverse and inclusive work environment, fostering openness, sincerity, and collaboration. Located in Hagastaden, Stockholm's Life Science Hub, our modern and creative workspace includes an in-house gym, yoga, and social activities like ping pong, table football, and regular after-work events. Our bistro serves a fantastic lunch buffet, and we offer morning- and afternoon-fika every day. Our rooftop terrace also provides a stunning 360-degree view of Stockholm, enhancing the work experience. All of this comes attached with a competitive compensation and benefits package.
   

  

**Application**
 Please apply to the position through the application form below. Selection and interviews will be ongoing. We do not accept applications by e-mail.

title: Presales Engineer – HPE Infrastructure

 Working at the intersection of technology and business, you'll help partners design the right infrastructure solutions, support them throughout the sales process, and strengthen their technical capabilities through enablement and training.
   

  

 You'll play a key role in helping our partners grow their HPE business while building long-term relationships across the Nordic channel ecosystem.

 You have:

title: Business Unit Manager - IBM
description:
**Why Choose TD SYNNEX**
**TD SYNNEX** 
 is a
 **Fortune 500 IT company** 
 and one of the world's largest technology distributors, with
 **22,000 employees** 
 operating across more than
 **100 countries** 
 . We help businesses maximize the value of technology through innovative solutions, services, and partnerships.
   

  

**About The Role**
 IBM is a strategic growth vendor for TD SYNNEX across Europe. This role offers the opportunity to contribute to the expansion of our IBM portfolio, helping partners accelerate their digital transformation through innovative IBM solutions.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* Define and execute the long-term business strategy and annual plans for IBM solutions and services across Europe.
* Own the business P&L, managing revenue, profitability, budgets, investments, forecasts, and resource allocation.
* Lead senior-level relationships with IBM, aligning strategic priorities and driving successful go-to-market execution.
* Shape the future direction of the IBM hardware and software portfolio, identifying growth opportunities, target markets, and partner segments.
* Drive commercial execution through effective management of pipeline, forecasting, partner development, renewals, strategic opportunities, and demand-generation activities.
* Coordinate cross-functional teams including Sales, Business Development, Product Management, Technical Pre-Sales, Solution Architecture, Marketing, Finance, and Operations.
* Establish governance frameworks, performance reviews, accountability measures, and operating rhythms that support business objectives.
* Provide senior leadership with clear forecasts, business insights, risk assessments, and recommendations for continuous improvement.
* Lead, coach, and develop managers and specialists, fostering a collaborative, inclusive, and high-performance culture.


**What We're Looking For**
* Minimum of 5 years of leadership experience in B2B sales, business development, business unit management, or operations within the IT industry.
* Strong understanding of enterprise technology solutions; experience with IBM software, infrastructure, services, or comparable vendor portfolios is highly desirable.
* Proven track record of managing P&L performance, budgets, forecasting, investments, and resource planning.
* Strong strategic and commercial mindset with the ability to translate market insights and vendor strategies into actionable business plans.
* Deep understanding of the European IT channel ecosystem, including distributors, resellers, systems integrators, managed service providers, and vendor partnerships.
* Demonstrated success in building, mentoring, and leading high-performing teams across multiple functions, countries, or regions.
* Excellent stakeholder management, negotiation, and influencing skills with senior vendor, partner, and internal leadership audiences.
* Fluent Swedish and English, both written and spoken; additional European languages are considered an advantage.


**What We Offer**
* Continuous learning and professional development opportunities with clear career progression paths.
* Hybrid work (2 - 3 days at the office per week)
* Comprehensive benefits package including health insurance, paid leave, retirement plans
* Certified Workplace Excellence: Work for a certified Great Place to Work organization.


 At TD SYNNEX, our values guide everything we do: Together, We Own It, We Dare to Go, We Grow and Win, and above all, We Do the Right Thing. These principles shape how we work with each other, our partners, and our communities as we drive innovation and create lasting impact.
   

  

**What's In It For You?**
* Elective Benefits: Our programs are tailored to your country to best accommodate your lifestyle.
* Grow Your Career: Accelerate your path to success (and keep up with the future) with formal programs on leadership and professional development, and many more on-demand courses.
* Elevate Your Personal Well-Being: Boost your financial, physical, and mental well-being through seminars, events, and our global Life Empowerment Assistance Program.
* Diversity, Equity & Inclusion: It's not just a phrase to us; valuing every voice is how we succeed. Join us in celebrating our global diversity through inclusive education, meaningful peer-to-peer conversations, and equitable growth and development opportunities.
* Make the Most of our Global Organization: Network with other new co-workers within your first 30 days through our onboarding program.
* Connect with Your Community: Participate in internal, peer-led inclusive communities and activities, including business resource groups, local volunteering events, and more environmental and social initiatives.

 At TD SYNNEX, we're proud to be recognized as a great place to work and a leader in the promotion and practice of diversity, equity and inclusion. If you're excited about working for our company and believe you're a good fit for this role, we encourage you to apply. You may be exactly the person we're looking for!

title: Avdelningschef till Customer, Metering & Grid Architecture inom Vattenfall Eldistribution
description:
Vattenfall Eldistribution spelar en central roll i energiomställningen. Elektrifieringen av industri, transporter och samhälle driver omfattande investeringar i elnätet och ställer nya krav på vår förmåga att utveckla verksamhet, arbetssätt och digitala lösningar.
   

  

 Samtidigt genomför vi en omfattande modernisering av vårt IT-landskap med strategiska satsningar inom bland annat data, integration, kundlösningar och affärskritiska plattformar.
   

  

 För att lyckas behöver vi en stark arkitekturfunktion som skapar riktning, möjliggör förändring och säkerställer att våra lösningar är hållbara, säkra och skalbara över tid. Nu söker vi en engagerad ledare som vill vara med och utveckla vår arkitekturförmåga och bidra till framtidens energisystem.
   

  

**Ansvarsområden och arbetsuppgifter** 

 Arkitekturfunktionen Inom Vattenfall Eldistribution Består Idag Av 17 Medarbetare Och Befinner Sig i En Expansiv Fas. För Att Möta Den Ökande Efterfrågan På Arkitekturstöd, Stärka Vårt Ledarskap Och Skapa Ännu Bättre Förutsättningar För Verksamhetsnära Utveckling Etablerar Vi Två Avdelningar
   

  

* IT, OT & Operations Architecture
* Customer, Metering & Grid Architecture


 Som Avdelningschef för Customer, Metering & Grid Architecture leder du ett team om cirka 10–12 seniora arkitekter och specialister, bestående av både medarbetare och konsulter. Teamet ansvarar för domän-, verksamhets- och lösningsarkitektur inom några av Vattenfall Eldistributions strategiska verksamhetsområden;
   

  

* Kund och marknad
* Mätning och nätanslutning
* Nätutveckling och investeringar
* Projektgenomförande
* Verksamhetsstödjande funktioner såsom HR, ekonomi och inköp


 Rollen är central i vår fortsatta digitalisering och verksamhetsutveckling. Du ansvarar för att utveckla teamet, stärka arkitekturförmågan och säkerställa att arkitekturen bidrar till verksamhetsmål, strategiska prioriteringar och långsiktigt hållbara lösningar. I nära samarbete med verksamheten, IT-organisationen och övriga arkitekturfunktioner skapar du förutsättningar för ökad genomförandekraft, effektivare arbetssätt och ett framtidssäkrat IT-landskap.
   

  

 Du rapporterar till Chefen för Arkitektur, som ingår i Vattenfall Eldistributions IT-ledning. Tillsammans med ytterligare en avdelningschef utgör du Arkitekturledningen, med ansvar för att leda och vidareutveckla företagets arkitekturförmåga.
   

  

 Rollen omfattar verksamhets-, personal-, budget- och arbetsmiljöansvar med särskilt fokus på ledarskap, kompetensutveckling och att bygga en högpresterande och verksamhetsnära arkitekturfunktion. Som ledare för seniora arkitekter förväntas du samtidigt bidra med strategisk arkitekturriktning och fungera som rådgivare och bollplank till verksamhetsledning, IT-ledning och andra centrala intressenter.
   

  

**Dina Huvudsakliga Ansvarsområden**
* Leda, utveckla och coacha ett team om cirka 10–12 seniora arkitekter och specialister.
* Ansvara för verksamhet, personal, budget och arbetsmiljö inom avdelningen.
* Sätta mål, prioriteringar och riktning för teamets arbete samt följa upp resultat och leveranser.
* Säkerställa rätt kompetens, kapacitet och förmåga för att möta verksamhetens behov.
* Vidareutveckla arkitekturförmågan och stärka samarbetet mellan verksamhet, IT och koncernens centrala arkitekturfunktioner.
* Bidra till den digitala transformationen och den långsiktiga utvecklingen av Vattenfall Eldistributions arkitektur, strategi och digitala förmågor.


 Kvalifikationer
   

  

 Vi söker dig som kombinerar ett starkt ledarskap med gedigen erfarenhet av arkitektur, verksamhetsutveckling och digital transformation.
   

  

**Vi Tror Att Du Har**
* Akademisk examen inom IT, systemvetenskap, datavetenskap eller motsvarande.
* Flerårig erfarenhet av att leda medarbetare, arkitektteam eller större förändringsinitiativ.
* Erfarenhet av att leda och utveckla seniora specialister.
* Minst fem års erfarenhet i en senior arkitektroll, exempelvis som Enterprise-, Domän- eller Verksamhetsarkitekt.
* Erfarenhet av arkitekturarbete i agila organisationer.
* Mycket god förmåga att kommunicera på svenska och engelska.
* Relevant certifiering eller vidareutbildning inom arkitektur samt erfarenhet av CRM, kundplattformar, MDM, Smart Metering, SAP EAM, ISO 55000, GIS är meriterande.


**Vem är du?**
 Du är en trygg och engagerande ledare som utvecklar människor, bygger starka samarbeten och skapar resultat genom andra. Du är kommunikativ, förändringsdriven och skicklig på att omsätta strategi till praktik. Med ett strukturerat och pragmatiskt arbetssätt skapar du riktning och framdrift även i komplexa miljöer.
   

  

 Vi lägger stor vikt vid dina personliga egenskaper, ditt ledarskap och din förmåga att skapa långsiktiga resultat genom team och samverkan.
   

  

 Ytterligare information
   

  

**Vi erbjuder**
*Förutom att du får vara med och forma framtidens smarta energisamhälle erbjuder vi dig ett utvecklande och omväxlande arbete med många kontaktytor. För oss på Vattenfall är det viktigt att arbete och privatliv har en god balans, därför erbjuder vi flexibilitet i arbetet samt möjlighet till att arbeta hemifrån vid behov. Vi har även en hel del andra personalförmåner som exempelvis arbetstidsförkortning, förmånliga tjänstepensionsavtal, föräldraledighetstillägg med mera. Läs mer om våra förmåner här.*
**Placeringsort**
 Solna, Trollhättan eller Luleå
   

  

**För mer information** 
 om själva tjänsten kontakta rekryterande chef Jenny Brodin, +46703056791. För frågor om rekryteringsprocessen kontakta Executive rekryterare Cecilia Wijkman, cecilia.wijkman@vattenfall.com
   

  

 Fackliga representanter för denna tjänst är Christian Ericsson, Ledarna, Anne-Marie Sjöbohm, Akademikerna, Jan-Olof Eriksson, Unionen, Ulf Tengman, SEKO. Alla kontaktpersoner nås via Vattenfalls växel 08-739 50 00
   

  

**Välkommen med din ansökan senast 7 september 2026.** 
 Urval och intervjuer sker fortlöpande. Vi tar endast emot ansökningar via vår webbplats. Vi tar inte emot personligt brev i ansökan. Du söker snabbt och enkelt genom att svara på urvalsfrågor och bifoga ditt CV.
   

  

 På Vattenfall värdesätter vi att vara aktiva, positiva, öppna och säkerhetsmedvetna. Vi söker medarbetare som delar vår vision och kan bidra till att stärka vår företagskultur. Vi är övertygade om att mångfald bidrar till att bygga ett mer lönsamt och tilltalande företag och strävar efter att vara goda förebilder när det gäller mångfald. Vattenfall arbetar aktivt för att alla medarbetare ska ha samma möjligheter och rättigheter oavsett ålder, etnisk eller kulturell bakgrund, könstillhörighet, religion/tro, sexuell läggning eller funktionsvariation. Läs mer om hur vi arbetar med mångfald och inkludering här.
   

  

 Då säkerheten för Vattenfall och dess anställda är avgörande kommer vi innan varje anställning genomföra en ”pre-employment screening”. Dessa kontroller baseras på din roll som du kommer att fylla inom Vattenfall.
   

  

*Att arbeta inom Vattenfall innebär att arbeta med samhällsviktig infrastruktur. Därmed är många av våra tjänster säkerhetsklassade och du kan komma att bli krigsplacerad. Är denna tjänst säkerhetsklassad kommer säkerhetsprövning genomföras innan anställning, i enlighet med säkerhetsskyddslagen. En eventuell krigsplacering sker med stöd i anställningsavtalet och lagen om totalförsvarsplikt.*
 Vi ser fram emot din ansökan!
   

  

 Företagsbeskrivning
   

  

 Vattenfall är en av Europas största producenter och återförsäljare av el och värme. Våra huvudmarknader är Sverige, Tyskland, Nederländerna, Danmark och Storbritannien. Inom Vattenfallkoncernen finns cirka 21 000 anställda. Vi har elektrifierat industrier, levererat energi till bostäder och förvandlat tillvaron genom innovation i över hundra års tid.
   

  

 Vattenfall Eldistribution AB är Vattenfalls elnätsverksamhet och ett av Sveriges största elnätsföretag. Vi ansvarar för en samhällsbärande infrastruktur som distribuerar el till mer än 900 000 företag och hushåll. Som medarbetare hos oss bidrar du varje dag till att samhället fungerar och till en säker elförsörjning för kommande generationer. Tillsammans bygger vi framtidens elnät och möjliggör omställningen till ett hållbart samhälle. Läs mer om hur det är att arbeta här

title: Leverantörsstyrningsspecialist Skandiabanken
description:
*Har du ett brinnande intresse för IT, för att skapa struktur, ordning och reda i syfte att optimera IT-leveranser? Som Leverantörsstyrningsspecialist får du en central roll i att utveckla och driva bankens leverantörsstyrning kopplat till outsourcing och DORA-regelverket. Du blir en nyckelspelare i gränslandet mellan IT, affär och regelverk, där du bidrar till både stabil leverans och fortsatt utveckling i en verksamhet med höga ambitioner och stort förändringsfokus. Hjärtligt välkommen till Skandiabanken!* 
 💚
   

  

**Att jobba som Leverantörsstyrningsspecialist**
 I rollen arbetar du med att säkerställa att Skandiabanken styr sina outsourcade IT‑leverantörer på ett strukturerat, effektivt och regelrätt sätt. Du ansvarar för ramverk, processer och uppföljning inom outsourcing och har en viktig roll i att stötta verksamheten i hur leverantörer ska hanteras och följas upp.
   

  

 Du Fungerar Som Ett Expertstöd i Frågor Som Rör IT‑leverantörer Och Outsourcing – Både Operativt Och Strategiskt. Tjänsten Innebär Utöver Att Säkerställa Att Skandiabankens Outsourcing Sker Enligt Gällande Regelverk Även Att Tillse Att IT-leveranserna Optimeras Genom En Tydlig Uppföljning Och Kravställan. Det Innebär Att Du Exempelvis
   

  

* driver och utvecklar arbetet med leverantörsstyrning och outsourcingramverk
* stöttar verksamheten i analyser, uppföljning och dialoger med leverantörer
* säkerställer att interna regelverk och externa krav efterlevs
* ansvarar för dokumentation, register och klassificering kopplat till outsourcing
* representerar banken i forum internt och externt, inklusive dialog med tillsynsmyndigheter


 Rollen innebär många kontaktytor – både inom CIO‑funktionen, med verksamheten och med externa leverantörer – där du förväntas växla mellan att vara en drivande kraft och ett rådgivande expertstöd. Du blir en del av ett kompetent team i förändring, där du har stora möjligheter att tillsammans med dina kollegor påverka hur arbetet med leverantörsstyrning utvecklas framåt.
   

  

**För att lyckas i rollen**
 Vi söker dig som har;
   

  

* Akademisk examen, gärna med IT‑inriktning
* Erfarenhet av leverantörsstyrning kopplat till IT, inklusive inköp och uppföljning
* Erfarenhet av arbete i eller nära en IT‑organisation
* Erfarenhet av metodisk leverantörsstyrning, inklusive uppföljning av kommersiella villkor och KPI:er
* God förmåga att förstå och diskutera IT‑lösningar med tekniska specialister
* Erfarenhet av relevanta regulatoriska krav inom bank/finans (t.ex. DORA, GDPR)
* Mycket god förmåga att kommunicera på svenska och engelska i både tal och skrift


 Meriterande;
   

  

* Erfarenhet från bank eller annan finansiell verksamhet
* Erfarenhet från både leverantörs- och beställarsidan inom IT


 För att trivas och lyckas i rollen behöver du ha en stark affärsförståelse och en förmåga att se helheten – där du väger kvalitet, kostnad, risk och innovation mot varandra. Du är strategisk i ditt tänkande och har en naturlig fallenhet för att bygga långsiktiga relationer, samtidigt som du är tydlig och trygg i din kommunikation.
   

  

 Du trivs i en roll där du både driver frågor framåt och stöttar andra, och har förmågan att navigera i komplexa miljöer med många intressenter. Din pedagogiska förmåga gör att du kan omsätta tekniska resonemang till affärsvärde, och du bygger förtroende såväl internt som externt.
   

  

**Vad händer nu?**
 Vi arbetar med löpande urval, så skicka gärna in din ansökan redan idag, men i och med stundande semestertider tar vi ett uppehåll i rekryteringsprocessen och
 **återupptar urval och intervjuerna** 
 i
 **mitten av augusti** 
 . Varmt välkommen med din ansökan, och trevlig sommar! 🌞
   

  

 Rekryteringsprocessen innehåller intervjuer, tester, bakgrundskontroll samt digital referenstagning för att säkerställa en rättvis och objektiv bedömning.
   

  

 Om du har frågor kring rollen, vänligen kontakta rekryterande chef Emma Spjuth på emma.spjuth@skandia.se
   

  

 Om du har frågor kring rekryteringsprocessen, vänligen kontakta Talent Acquisition Partner Susanne Hedberg på susanne.hedberg@skandia.se
   

  

 Vi återkopplar till alla som söker, oavsett om du går vidare i processen eller inte.
   

  

  

  

**Varmt välkommen med din ansökan!**
**Mer om Banken**
 Vi har varit pionjärer inom digital bankverksamhet sedan starten 1994, som Sveriges första helt digitala bank. Med en passion för innovation och kundfokus har vi vuxit till att erbjuda ett brett utbud av produkter och tjänster inom områdena Låna, Spara och Betala – med särskilt fokus på bolån.
   

  

 Vår verksamhet är fördelad mellan Stockholm och Linköping. I Stockholm finns majoriteten av vår verksamhet, medan vår kundservice har sitt hjärta i Linköping. Tillsammans är vi cirka 270 medarbetare anställda på banken som varje dag skapar smarta lösningar för våra kunder.
   

  

**Vårt Erbjudande Inkluderar**
* Låna: Transparenta och attraktivt prissatta bolån
* Spara: Sparande i fonder och aktier samt på sparkonto
* Betala: Lönekonto samt smidiga kort- och betalningstjänster.


 Vi tror på att människor som utvecklas, presterar och mår bra är nyckeln till framgång. Hos oss är kompetensutveckling och lärande självklara delar av vardagen – framåt tillsammans!

* Sätta mål, prioriteringar och riktning för teamets arbete samt följa upp resultat och leveranser.
* Säkerställa rätt kompetens, kapacitet och förmåga för att möta verksamhetens behov.
* Vidareutveckla arkitekturförmågan och stärka samarbetet mellan verksamhet, IT och koncernens centrala arkitekturfunktioner.
* Bidra till den digitala transformationen och den långsiktiga utvecklingen av Vattenfall Eldistributions arkitektur, strategi och digitala förmågor.


 Kvalifikationer
   

  

 Vi söker dig som kombinerar ett starkt ledarskap med gedigen erfarenhet av arkitektur, verksamhetsutveckling och digital transformation.
   

  

****Vi Tror Att Du Har:****
* Akademisk examen inom IT, systemvetenskap, datavetenskap eller motsvarande.
* Flerårig erfarenhet av att leda medarbetare, arkitektteam eller större förändringsinitiativ.
* Erfarenhet av att leda och utveckla seniora specialister.
* Minst fem års erfarenhet i en senior arkitektroll, exempelvis som Enterprise-, Domän- eller Verksamhetsarkitekt.
* Erfarenhet av arkitekturarbete i agila organisationer.
* Mycket god förmåga att kommunicera på svenska och engelska.
* Relevant certifiering eller vidareutbildning inom arkitektur samt erfarenhet av CRM, kundplattformar, MDM, Smart Metering, SAP EAM, ISO 55000, GIS är meriterande.


**Vem är du?**
 Du är en trygg och engagerande ledare som utvecklar människor, bygger starka samarbeten och skapar resultat genom andra. Du är kommunikativ, förändringsdriven och skicklig på att omsätta strategi till praktik. Med ett strukturerat och pragmatiskt arbetssätt skapar du riktning och framdrift även i komplexa miljöer.

title: Risk Specialist - Principal
description:
**This is Worldline**
 Worldline helps businesses of all shapes and sizes to accelerate their growth journey - quickly, simply, and securely. We are the innovators at the heart of the payments technology industry, shaping how the world pays and gets paid. Our technology powers the growth of millions of businesses across 5 continents. And just as we help our customers accelerate their business, we are committed to helping our people accelerate their careers. Together, we shape the evolution.
   

  

**The O** 
**pportunity**
 The Risk Officer is a critical role within the second line of defense for the Merchant Services (MS) Division within Worldline. In this role you will be a part of the team leading the charge in strengthening our company's internal controls and risk management processes. If you're someone with an ability to explain risk concepts, a liking for facilitating risk workshops and a keen interest in ICT risk management, we'd love to hear from you.
   

  

 Reporting directly to the Entity’s Chief Risk and Compliance, and also supporting your local entity’s management team and senior specialists, you'll play an integral role in driving the effective operation of our operating environment. You will be supported by the global entity risk officer network and will also participate in global risk initiatives to ensure that risk management industry best practices are rolled-out across the Merchant Services Division.
   

  

 You will be part of a team with many experienced and dedicated risk officers spread across the world that would love for you to work with them! We are committed to continuous improvement and are always looking for new talents to join our group of trusted risk advisors to the business
 *.* 

**Day-to-Day Responsibilities**
* Advocate for a sound risk management culture through awareness and stakeholder engagement within Sweden, ensuring inter-departmental collaborations.
* Develop tools, processes and procedures for operational risk management, with focus on ICT-risk including Third-party risk.
* Providing risk expertise and collaborate with the local management team and senior specialists to design an effective control environment.
* Facilitate enterprise wide operational risk and control assessments as well as specific ICT and Third Party risk assessments across the company's operations
* Coordinate and independently challenge risk assessments of new products, services, organizational units, and significant changes
* Analyze the effectiveness of controls and other mitigating measures and suggesting improvements
* Develop and oversee compliance with operational risk policies, ensuring adherence to regulatory requirements, both locally and in our business globally.


**Who Are We Looking For**
 We look for big thinkers. People who can drive positive change, step up and show what’s next – people with passion, can-do attitude and a hunger to learn and grow. In practice this means:
   

  

* 4+ years within a 2nd line Risk Management and/or Control Function role.
* Excellent knowledge and awareness related to enterprise and operational risk management industry best practices and frameworks (e.g., COSO, ISO 31000).
* Knowledge about DORA, incl incident- and third party risk management.
* Experience in or with strongly regulated institutions and industries.
* Self-driven ethics and initiative in assignments and stakeholder management.
* Ability to present and influence decision making with executive audiences.
* Experience working in matrix organizations.
* Not a must but would be great if you have some of the following skills, too:
* Industry experience in payment and/or banking
* Bachelor’s Degree (Economics, Business Administration, Finance, or equivalent)
* Industry Risk Management Certifications (CRMA, CRISC, CISA etc.)
* Risk Management / GRC tool experience
* Experience with analytics and automation tooling (Power BI, Power Apps)
* A constructive, positive, and dynamic attitude, exemplified through proactive problem-solving and enthusiastic collaboration, is beneficial to the role.


**Perks & Benefits**
 At Worldline you’ll get the chance to be at the heart of the global payments technology industry and shape how the world pays and gets paid. On top of that, you will also:
   

  

* Be part of a company guided by a strong purpose to do good and recognized as top 1% of the most sustainable companies in all sectors worldwide
* Work with inspiring colleagues and be empowered to learn, grow, and accelerate your career
* Health contribution
* Health check – Every 2:nd year
* Pension: BTP1 & BTP2
* Private Health Care Insurance (Euro Accident)
* Parental pay and 12 months pension during parental leave
* Opportunity to hybrid working according to company standard
* Benefit portal with many great offers, plus more.


**Shape the evolution**
 We are pushing towards the next frontiers of payments technology, and we look for big thinkers to join our journey. People with passion, can-do attitude and a hunger to learn and grow. Here you’ll work with ambitious colleagues from around the world, take on unique challenges as a team, and make a real impact on the society. And with our empowering culture, strong technology and extensive training opportunities, we help you accelerate your career. Wherever you decide to go. Join our global team of over 18,000 innovators across 40+ countries, and shape a tomorrow that is yours to own.
   

  

**Learn more about life at Worldline at** 
**jobs.worldline.com**
**We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as an individual with a disability, or any applicable legally protected characteristics.**

title: Researcher in Video Coding
description:
**Grow with us**
**About The Opportunity**
 Ericsson is Europe’s leading network technology company and a global pioneer shaping the 6G era. Our 6G vision will transform business and society in the 2030s through secure, efficient, and sustainable communications.
   

  

 Video already accounts for 75% of mobile data traffic. In an AI-enabled world of immersive experiences, digital twins, autonomous systems, and generative media, advanced video coding is indispensable. To deliver these services on a global scale, video compression and standards must keep advancing in efficiency, flexibility, and sustainability.
   

  

 Join our international team of world-class researchers at the forefront of both advanced signal processing and neural network–based compression. You will invent, implement, and evaluate algorithms that power next-generation video coding standards shaping the technology stack of 6G and AI-native media.
   

  

**What You Will Do**
* Invent novel video coding tools (signal processing and neural approaches) to improve video coding performance and efficiency as well as invent ways to increase robustness and flexibility of video coding standards.
* Implement inventions in software (C++/Python) and run large-scale evaluations.
* Contribute to global video coding standardization such as JVET/MPEG, author patents and publications.
* Collaborate with researchers and engineers across Ericsson as well as leading industry and academia experts globally.
* Be working in a dynamic team with opportunities for learning, taking on new responsibilities, impacting ways of working, and much more.


**The Skills You Bring**
 We welcome outstanding graduates, postdocs, and experienced researchers passionate about video coding innovation who:
   

  

* Hold an M.Sc. or Ph.D. in a relevant technical field.
* Are exceptional problem solvers with a passion for innovation.
* Write high-quality, efficient code and are strong in C++ and/or Python.
* Are curious, collaborative, and able to communicate complex ideas clearly.


**Nice to have:**
* Experience in video coding and processing.
* Experience in signal processing and neural networks applied to compression or video processing.
* Familiarity with standards such as H.265/HEVC and H.266/VVC.
* Contributions to standardization, publications, or talks at conferences/industry events.


**Why join Ericsson:**
* Be part of Europe’s leading tech company at the forefront of 6G and global standards.
* Work with a top-tier international research team and have your work validated and recognized on the world stage.
* Have a real impact at scale with your innovations targeting billions of devices and a large share of global data traffic.
* Grow in a dynamic environment with strong mentorship, learning opportunities, and real impact.
* Perform at your best, enabled by a healthy work-life balance and a commitment to long-term, sustainable progress.


**Location:** 
 for this job opportunity is Stockholm Sweden. For exceptional candidates other locations may be considered
   

  

**How to apply:**
 Send your application and describe how your experience and skills will advance state-of-the-art video coding for the AI-enabled 6G world.
   

  

**What happens once you apply?** 
 Click Here to find all you need to know about what our typical hiring process looks like.We encourage you to consider applying to jobs where you might not meet all the criteria. We recognize that we all have transferrable skills, and we can support you with the skills that you need to develop.Encouraging a diverse and inclusive organization is core to our values at Ericsson, that's why we champion it in everything we do. We truly believe that by collaborating with people with different experiences we drive innovation, which is essential for our future growth. We encourage people from all backgrounds to apply and realize their full potential as part of our Ericsson team. Ericsson is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. learn more.

title: Senior Product Manager – Financial Engineering - Tax Solutions
description:
The Platform team creates the technology that enables Spotify to learn quickly and scale easily, enabling rapid growth in our users and our business around the globe. Spanning many disciplines, we work to make the business work; creating the infrastructure, tooling, frameworks, and capabilities needed to welcome a billion customers.
   

  

 At Spotify, our Financial Engineering teams build and scale the internal systems that power global financial operations across a rapidly evolving business. Within the FinE Alliance, you’ll work closely with Tax, Treasury, Accounting, and Engineering partners to shape products that enable operational excellence, compliance, and automation at global scale. This role sits at the intersection of finance, product strategy, enterprise systems, and engineering, helping Spotify continuously improve how financial processes operate across regions and regulatory environments.
   

  

 What You'll Do
   

  

* Partner closely with Tax teams to agree on vision, strategy and roadmap, as well as understand tax processes, compliance requirements, reporting needs, and risk areas.
* Own the product strategy and roadmap for Spotify’s tax technology ecosystem, balancing internal platform development with third-party SaaS solutions.
* Drive discovery, prioritization, and execution across financial engineering initiatives that support tax operations, treasury processes, and regulatory reporting.
* Translate complex financial and regulatory requirements into intuitive product experiences and actionable technical requirements.
* Collaborate with Engineering, Data, Platform, and Finance teams to deliver secure, scalable, and well-integrated solutions.
* Lead cross-functional conversations around trade-offs, dependencies, and long-term platform strategy while maintaining momentum on iterative delivery.
* Partner with external vendors and SaaS providers to ensure reliable integrations, system performance, and operational continuity.
* Build strong relationships across Finance leadership and become a trusted advisor on product direction, risks, and delivery planning.
* Improve visibility, controls, and data quality across tax-related systems and workflows.
* Champion user-centric product thinking while ensuring enterprise-grade governance, auditability, and scalability.


 Who You Are
   

  

* You have experience building or managing products within accounting, tax technology, fintech, ERP, or enterprise financial systems environments.
* You are experienced partnering with Finance, Tax, Treasury, or Accounting stakeholders in global organizations.
* You know how to translate complex operational or compliance requirements into clear product strategies, roadmaps, and delivery plans.
* You are comfortable navigating ambiguity and balancing the needs of multiple stakeholders across technical and non-technical teams.
* You have experience working with SaaS platforms such as NetSuite, Vertex, Oracle, SAP, or similar enterprise financial systems.
* You have strong product management fundamentals, including backlog prioritization, product discovery, roadmap planning, and iterative delivery.
* You care deeply about building scalable systems with reliable controls, integrations, and high-quality user experiences.
* You are an excellent communicator who can simplify technical and financial complexity for different audiences.
* You have experience working in hybrid technology environments that combine vendor platforms with internally built systems.
* You thrive in collaborative, cross-functional environments and enjoy solving operational challenges through technology.


 Where You'll Be
   

  

* This role is based in London or Stockholm.
* We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best! There will be some in person meetings, but still allows for flexibility to work from home.


 We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us. Find our AI notice here: https://lifeatspotify.com/ai-notice
   

  

 Today, we are the world’s most popular audio streaming subscription service.

title: Fullstack AI Engineer
description:
Do you want to join the technological revolution? Tendium is looking for a Fullstack AI Engineer to join our team.
  
About Tendium
  
Tendium is the global pioneer in AI-driven public tender management, transforming how companies discover, analyse, and win government contracts. Our platform turns complex processes into something simple and transparent, empowering businesses to compete fairly for billions in public sector opportunities. We’ve been building our AI-native platform since 2018, leveraging a vast data moat, agentic AI, and tens of thousands of hours of R&D. Today, we serve large numbers of customers across Europe and are rapidly scaling.
  
If you’re ready to make an impact and grow with us, we want to hear from you.
  
What you'll do
  
As a fullstack engineer, you are comfortable working across the whole stack, building intuitive user experiences as well as backend services and some dev-ops. You will build state-of-the-art solutions using modern LLMs and agentic technologies, applying them directly to real product challenges. You’ll take ownership from understanding the problem to deploying and refining features that create meaningful value for users.
  
You’ll work closely with product, design, and engineering to shape what we build. This includes rapid prototyping, exploring current LLM and agentic methods, and turning them into reliable, production-ready systems, both in backend and frontend.
  
We release early and iterate based on real usage. This role suits someone who enjoys combining strong engineering skills with modern AI methods and who wants to push the boundaries of what our software can do.
  
  

**You will:**  

Work across the tech stack together with your team mates. You are probably more passionate about either frontend or backend but comfortable working in both.
  
  

Deeply understand our users and the challenges of navigating complex procurement data.
  
  

Design, build, and refine AI systems, from prompt-driven models to multi-step agent flows.
  
  

**Own features end to end:** discovery, modeling, evaluation, deployment, and iteration.
  
  

Integrate AI outputs into product features that users trust and rely on.
  
  

Collaborate with product and design to explore what AI should accomplish for procurement teams.
  
  

Balance rapid experimentation with building scalable, maintainable AI systems.
  
  

**What you'll bring:**  

Several years of experience as a software engineer. You have worked across the stack, even if you might have spent the majority of the time in backend or frontend.
  
  

A product mindset and the ability to choose the right approach by understanding the problem first.
  
  

Strong engineering fundamentals, with the ability to work effortlessly across the stack.
  
  

Experience or very eager to learn how to design agentic workflows, retrieval-augmented systems, or evaluation pipelines.
  
  

Comfortable with ambiguity and the ability to turn fuzzy problems into clear, workable solutions.
  
  

Based in Stockholm, within commuting distance from our office in central Stockholm.
  
  

Fluent in English.
  
  

**Our tech stack:**  

TypeScript, React, Node.js, Python GraphQL
  
  

PostgreSQL, Opensearch, Athena
  
  

AWS
  
  

**Microservice Architecture:** Fargate, Lambda, SQS, EventBridge, GraphQL, OpenAPI
  
  

**AI Tooling:** Claude Code, Internal MCP Server
  
  

How we Work
  
We’re agile but not dogmatic. We ship minimum viable products, iterate based on real feedback, and aim for quality without overengineering. Great ideas come from anywhere, and you’ll influence not just what we build, but how we work.
  
Culture at Tendium
  
We move fast, stay curious, and take ownership. We’re a tight-knit team with a shared drive to fix how public procurement works, and we’re just getting started.
  
Our culture is built on trust, collaboration, and learning. You’ll have real responsibility from day one, supported by teammates who challenge you, help you grow, and want to build something meaningful together.
  
We’re Stockholm-based with a hybrid setup, and we make time to connect through regular afterworks, team activities, and the kind of informal conversations that make work feel human.
  
We hire for talent, potential, and attitude. Different perspectives make the product better, and we’re building a team that reflects that.
  
If you want to build products that actually matter to the people who use them, let’s talk.
  
Application
  
We will be on vacations in July and will get back to you in August. We look forward to your application.
  
**Please note:** At the moment we are not able to sponsor VISA applications, so you need to have the right to work in Sweden.
  
To make this process even more efficient, feel free to sign in to your Connect profile and add your references at any stage.
  
Please find additional information on our recruitment process here. If you want to know more about our culture and what you can expect when working at Tendium you can read more about it here.
  
Equality and inclusion statement
  
At Tendium, we don’t just value diversity, we celebrate it. We’re building a workplace where everyone should feel that they belong, where your voice is heard, and your experiences are respected. Different perspectives fuel our creativity and drive innovation, and we’re always looking for people who can bring something new to the team. Whoever you are, wherever you're from, we’d love to hear from you. Let’s shape the future together.
